# Nodes

::: warning Preview version
The jsMind V2 programming API is currently a preview. The API will change in later updates. Please check this documentation anytime for the interface that is current.
:::

Nodes, their content, and the side values used when placing a child to the left or right of the root.

```ts
id: string
```

The unique identifier of the node.

### parent {#JmNode.parent}

```ts

```

```ts

```

### style {#JmNode.style}

```ts

```

Visual overrides for this node.

**Remarks**

Unset fields fall back to the theme. Storing only the difference keeps
theme changes propagating to every node that did not override anything.

## NodeCreationOptions {#NodeCreationOptions}

*Interface*

Options for creating a new node.

**Properties**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (optional) | `Record`<string, unknown> | Additional data for the node (default: {}). |
| `folded` (optional) | boolean | Whether the node is folded (default: false). |
| `nodeId` (optional) | string | Optional custom node ID. |
| `side` (optional) | [JmNodeSide](/en/reference/api/node#JmNodeSide) | Direction of the node (default: null). |
| `style` (optional) | [JmNodeStyle](/en/reference/api/style#JmNodeStyle) | Visual overrides for the node (default: none). |

## NodeDestinationOptions {#NodeDestinationOptions}

*Interface*

Options for specifying node destination.

**Properties**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `parentId` | string | The ID of the target parent node (required). |
| `position` (optional) | number | The position index among siblings (if not provided, adds to end). |
| `side` (optional) | [JmNodeSide](/en/reference/api/node#JmNodeSide) | The direction of the node (if not provided, keeps current direction). |
